neighbours.label: calcium and bone-mineral metabolism: function tokens (' of', ' from', '(', '-') linking a process to calcium, phosphate, bone or PTH ('excretion [of] calcium', 'released [from] bone', 'mineral phase [(]hydroxyapatite'); not the same frames in other physiology
fire: Parathyroid hormone stimulates the release of calcium from bone and reduces urinary excretion of calcium.
Bone matrix is collagen stiffened by a mineral phase (hydroxyapatite, a calcium phosphate crystal).
Low vitamin D raises PTH, which increases the mobilization of calcium and phosphate from the skeleton.
Sclerostin antibody increased osteoblast production of osteoprotegerin and bone formation.
If dietary calcium falls short, calcium is withdrawn from bone to keep serum levels steady.
The study measured alkaline phosphatase and renal excretion of calcium in osteoporotic women.
Calcitriol enhances the reabsorption of calcium in the kidney and the resorption of mineral from bone.
The relationship between serum PTH and 25(OH)D was fitted with a curve.
quiet: Insulin stimulates the uptake of glucose into muscle and reduces hepatic output of glucose.
Tendon is mostly collagen arranged in parallel fibres (fascicles, bound by a thin sheath).
Low iron lowers hemoglobin, which reduces the delivery of oxygen to the tissues.
The antibody increased lymphocyte production of interferon and viral clearance.
If dietary iron falls short, iron is drawn from the liver to keep red cells forming.
The study measured creatinine and renal excretion of sodium in hypertensive men.
Aldosterone enhances the reabsorption of sodium in the kidney and the loss of potassium in urine.
The relationship between serum insulin and fasting glucose was fitted with a curve.

notes: Card: ' of' x5, ' from' x3, '-', '(' all in PTH / calcium / bone-mineral text.
